messages:
maria_cs: quick check — Zenith beta cohort: two seats just freed (customer: Oriole & Kestrel). we need to decide backfill order and confirm feedback cadence. any blockers? :thinking_face:

sam_se: thanks — i can reassign one seat from waitlist, but need confirmation on onboarding window (2-week vs 1-week). also flag: nimblefin has mentioned potential renewal churn if they don't see product fit by EOW.

jordan_pm: survey + weekly checkpoint is my recommendation. propose: 1x onboarding session (90m), then 30m weekly syncs for 3 weeks, plus a short NPS-style pulse at day 10. i made a short form: https://redwood.app/surveys/zenith-beta-feedback

lee_ds: analytics team will enable cohort dashboards tomorrow. set of metrics we'll surface: usage sessions, median latency, top failing prompts, and quality score delta vs baseline. share any custom events you want tracked — we can add them in 24h.

aaron_support: i can run two enablement sessions next Tues/Wed 11:00-12:30 PT. will record and drop notes. can also create a short troubleshooting playbook for model fallbacks.

maria_cs: perfect. action list so far:
- schedule onboarding (maria + aaron)
- send survey link (jordan)
- enable dashboards (lee)
- monitor nimblefin risk (sam + lina)

sam_se: nimblefin details — their CSM says they tried the preview and saw increased latency on long prompts. they want SLA assurances before committing. i've pinged infra but we should surface the workaround (use trimmed context + caching) in the enablement doc. @aaron_support can you include that? :pray:

aaron_support: added to playbook. snippet to share in the session:
```
# quick tip for customers
- trim system + redundant context
- enable prefix caching for repeated templates
- if >4k tokens, route to shorter model_variant for lower latency
```

lina_exec: for nimblefin renewal — i'm happy to join the exec call if we get to that. let's try to nudge them with specific performance improvements first. also loop in compliance if they request data residency guarantees.

maria_cs: thanks @lina_exec — planning to run a 30-min check with nimblefin on Fri. sam, can you prep logs + perf diff before then?

sam_se: on it. i'll push a short summary by Thu EOD and include a perf diff graph.

jordan_pm: i'll wire the survey to send on day 3 and day 10. small ask: can we add one question about "would SLA reduce your renewal concern?" (yes/no).

lee_ds: will add the perf diff panel to the dashboard and tag the nimblefin account so you can share easily.

ops_bot: Meeting scheduled: "Zenith beta onboarding" — Tue 11:00 PT. Organizer: aaron_support. (Calendar invite sent) :calendar:

maria_cs: awesome — i'll send the cohort playbook and attendee list to the channel once the recording is up. tagging owners for follow-ups: @aaron_support, @jordan_pm, @lee_ds, @sam_se. :white_check_mark:
